title: Genetic and Molecular Bases of Mental Well-Being and Mindfulness
content: Genetic and Molecular Bases of Mental Well-being and Mindfulness is an exciting and quickly emerging research field that examines how the genetic and molecular bases of our biology (genetics and our molecular biology) can impact our mental well-being and our mindfulness practices, and aims to uncover the biological foundations of how we can begin to engage our mental well-being, stress-resilience, and mindfulness practices.
